name: traducao-do-antigravity-pt-br
description: Sistema autônomo e transparente de tradução para Português do Brasil do Antigravity

scripts.build:launcher: cargo build --release --manifest-path launcher/Cargo.toml && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('launcher/target/release/Antigravity-ptbr.exe', 'Antigravity-ptbr.exe'); require('fs').copyFileSync('launcher/target/release/Antigravity-ptbr.exe', 'launcher/Antigravity-ptbr.exe'); console.log('Launcher Antigravity-ptbr compilado com sucesso.');"
scripts.setup: npm run patch && npm run build:launcher && npm run create-shortcuts

author: Antigravity Community
